title: Message/set update unknown patch key returns invalidArguments not invalidProperties
description: In message.rs process_update, when the patch object contains an unknown key (anything other than 'readAt'), the handler returns json\!({"type": "invalidArguments", ...}). RFC 8620 §5.3 says: 'If the patch contains a property that does not exist or is read-only for this type, the server MUST use the invalidProperties SetError type.' This is a MUST violation. Contact/set process_update correctly uses invalidProperties for this case (line 351-356 in contact.rs). Message/set should be consistent and return invalidProperties with a 'properties' array listing the offending key.
